# Grist

Grist is a relational spreadsheet platform that combines the flexibility of a spreadsheet with the robustness of a database, allowing users to create custom applications tailored to their data needs.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/grist/.

## Actions

- **Add Records**: Add records to a specified table in a Grist document.
- **Delete Grist Table Records**: Delete records from a specified Grist table.
- **Fetch Column Metadata** (read-only): Fetch metadata for a specific column in a Grist document table.
- **Fetch Document Metadata** (read-only): Fetch metadata for a specified Grist document.
- **Fetch Table Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve metadata for a specified table in a Grist document.
- **Get Org Access** (read-only): Fetch org access details.
- **Get Users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of users via SCIM v2.
- **List Records** (read-only): Retrieve records from a specified table within a Grist document.
- **List Tables** (read-only): List all tables within a specified document.
- **Run SQL Query** (read-only): Execute a read-only SQL SELECT query on a Grist document.
- **Update Records**: Update records in a specified table within a document.
- **Create Document**: Create a document in a workspace.
- **Create Document Webhook**: Create a new webhook for a specified document.
- **Create SCIM User**: Create a new SCIM user.
- **Create Table**: Create tables in a document.
- **Delete Attachment**: Delete a specified attachment from a Grist document.
- **Delete Column**: Delete a column from a Grist document table.
- **Delete SCIM User**: Delete a specified user via SCIM.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook from a Grist document.
- **Download All Attachments Archive** (read-only): Download all attachments from a Grist document as a .zip or .tar archive.
- **Download Attachment** (read-only): Download the binary data of an attachment.
- **Download Grist Attachment Content** (read-only): Download the raw bytes of an attachment.
- **List Attachments** (read-only): List all attachments in a Grist document.
- **List Columns** (read-only): List all columns in a specified Grist table.
- **List Organizations** (read-only): List all organizations accessible to the authenticated user.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): List webhooks configured for a document.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): List all workspaces and documents accessible to the authenticated user on the current site.
- **Update Column Metadata**: Update metadata for one or more columns in a Grist document table.
- **Update Document Metadata**: Update metadata for a specified Grist document.
- **Update Table Metadata**: Update metadata for a specified table.
- **Update Webhook**: Update an existing webhook for a specified document.
- **Upload Attachment**: Upload one or more attachments to a Grist document.
